population: Four internally authored synthetic variants of the maintained API-load teaching example; no representative engineering population claim.
held_out_policy: Implementations may inspect fixture mechanics and trusted answer keys for software validation. Live worker outcomes from held-out cases must not be used to tune or rerun this pilot; retain first attempts and failures.
contrast: Identical structured semantic handoffs and authoritative EAL validation; only the negotiated protocol envelope, parser and durable delivery machinery differ.
same_in_both_arms: Model selection and host inference settings
Original task, exact requested scope, assessment time, claims and synthetic report information
Python EAL interpretation, installed methods and trusted fixture snapshots
Validator for entry, claim, source, context, assessment, observation references and time
Rejection diagnoses and a frozen first-attempt policy without repair turns
Reviewer receives a checked packet only following an accepted handoff
Tools, budgets and isolated per-case/arm workspace state

role_execution.budget_reporting: Record actual enforced ceilings, observed calls and elapsed time. Requested token or time ceilings that the host cannot enforce remain explicitly unenforced. No fabricated token receipts or USD costs.

trusted_fixture_policy.fixture_setup: Copy source, report and pinned collector into an empty isolated run workspace, preserving maintained example bytes.
trusted_fixture_policy.historical_time: Only trusted preparation uses explicit historical time. Registered model-facing MCP calls do not gain context or time override fields.
trusted_fixture_policy.scope_mismatch: Available persisted assessments identify demo-build-42; the task asks for demo-build-43. Reject the cross-build handoff. A correct reviewer answer keeps build-43 scope with null unassessed claim statuses and conclusion out_of_scope.
trusted_fixture_policy.stale: Assess 2026-09-25T10:00:00Z measurements at 2026-09-26T10:00:01Z; recollection cannot refresh observed_at.
trusted_fixture_policy.measured_failure: Keep all 100 attempted requests and latencies, increase failed requests from one to two, repin only the isolated fixture source digest.

statuses.performance_criteria_met: EAL status or null when unassessed
statuses.performance_criteria_failed: EAL status or null when unassessed

answer_contract.scope: Exact requested service, build_id, run_id, concurrent_clients and dataset

primary_outcome: Exact canonical scoped answer, including positive/failure/unavailable distinctions and production qualification
metrics: Answer correctness and justified unresolved outcome, distinct from handoff acceptance or rejection
Repairs and rejected or unresolved delivery attempts
End-to-end elapsed time, protocol/delivery bytes and coordination overhead
Measured model tokens and API cost only where actual usage receipts exist
analysis: Retain all eight scheduled pairs including failed, rejected, unannotated and unknown outcomes. Report paired descriptive counts and observed resource measures. These four task families are internally synthetic; no superiority, significance, capability gain or adoption claim is permitted from this pilot.
annotation: Canonical task fields are checked automatically. Additional prose is unscored unless a separate masked assessor and its human or AI provenance are retained.
failures: No silent repair, dropped unit, zero-cost imputation, answer-key substitution or live-result-dependent budget expansion.
